shortDescription: CALGARY, Alberta, Nov. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Parex Resources Inc. (“Parex” or the “Company”) TSX:PXT announces that it has received authorization from the Financial Superintendency of Colombia (“SFC”) to list its common shares on the Colombian Stock Exchange (“BVC”) and announces it will hos…

children: announces that it has received authorization from the Financial Superintendency of Colombia (“SFC”) to list its common shares on the Colombian Stock Exchange (“BVC”) and announces it will host a Capital Markets Day in Bogotá, Colombia on December 9, 2026.
“Our listing on the Colombian Stock Exchange marks an important milestone for Parex as Colombia’s largest independent oil and gas producer,” said Imad Mohsen, President & Chief Executive Officer.

“The listing underpins our commitment to Colombia, our trust in its institutions and financial system, and will expand our reach to new investors while providing Colombian stakeholders with an opportunity to participate directly in our growth as we continue to unlock the potential of our portfolio.”

The SFC has authorized the registration of the common shares of Parex in the National Registry of Securities and Issuers (“RNVE”) for the purpose of listing the shares for trading on the BVC, a key step in the Company’s dual listing. Parex anticipates that trading will commence shortly after it receives the necessary final approval of the BVC. The Company is not undertaking any capital raise with its dual listing on the BVC, and its issued share capital will be unaffected by the listing.
Parex will maintain its listing on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

A copy of the non-offering prospectus that Parex filed with the SFC as part of its listing application is available on its website at www.parexresources.com under Investors – Reports & Filings, together with an English translation of the document.

Parex will host a Capital Markets Day on Wednesday, December 9, 2026. The event will be webcast live from Bogotá, Colombia, with an in-person audience. Members of Parex’s executive team will provide an update on the Company’s strategy, transformed portfolio, long-term vision and growth potential.

Parex is the largest independent oil and gas company in Colombia, focusing on sustainable, conventional production. The Company’s corporate headquarters are in Calgary, Canada, with an operating office in Bogotá, Colombia. Parex shares trade on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol PXT.
